references.text: The peace offering (שְׁלָמִים) is described in detail in Leviticus, where the laws concerning this offering are given.
Further regulations regarding the peace offering and how it was to be eaten and handled.
The same type of offering was given by Nahshon, son of Amminadab, from the tribe of Judah - this shows the repeated pattern of gifts from tribal leaders.
Nethanel, son of Zuar, from Issachar gave the same peace offering, showing the unity in the gifts of the tribes.
Ahiezer's offering begins here - he was the leader of the tribe of Dan, son of Ammishaddai.
Ahiezer, son of Ammishaddai, is mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Dan at the census.
Ahiezer, son of Ammishaddai, led the camp of Dan on the north side of the tabernacle.
